capacity_gross_kwh.notes: 60.0 kWh nominal, CATL LFP (EV Database 2021-23 RWD; the existing OpenEV import for the 2026 Premium-I also shows 60/57). evspecifications lists 62 kWh for 2023-24, Wikipedia 64 kWh for the current RWD. evspecifications 2023 RWD (North America) shows LFP 170 kW; capacity taken from EV Database LFP60.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: 57.0 kWh usable (EV Database estimate). evspecifications 2023 RWD (North America) shows LFP 170 kW; capacity taken from EV Database LFP60.

chemistry.notes: LFP (CATL); evspecifications 2023/2024 RWD LFP. evspecifications 2023 RWD (North America) shows LFP 170 kW; capacity taken from EV Database LFP60.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: 400 V architecture (EV Database); evspecifications 345 V nominal. evspecifications 2023 RWD (North America) shows LFP 170 kW; capacity taken from EV Database LFP60.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Tesla's release note (2020.24.6.4, Model S/3/X/Y) says the car preconditions its battery when navigating to a fast charger; this is a software feature delivered to the whole Model 3 line (2023 RWD). Page mentions no manual battery-warming control. A manual control was neither found nor ruled out: Tesla's owner's manual pages were blocked (403) and scheduled-departure preconditioning in search excerpts is cabin-oriented.

dc_max_kw.notes: 170 kW (EV Database; evspecifications 2023 and 2024 RWD 170 kW; InsideEVs Highland: RWD 170 kW unchanged). evspecifications 2023 RWD (North America) shows LFP 170 kW; capacity taken from EV Database LFP60.
